description: Reorder one space: place it just before or just after another (pass exactly one of before/after). Renumbers every space's display order from 0, as the app's drag does. dry_run:true reports the new order without writing.

after.description: Place it just after this space.

before.description: Place it just before this space.

space.description: The space to move (id, slug or name).

name: move_space
